{{Quote|Vaius Antinus was a meticulous record keeper. These are the genealogies of all the great Sith of his days.|[[Talos Drellik]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Vaius Antinus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] record keeper who lived circa [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. He was a contemporary of several [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], such as [[Tulak Hord]] and [[Aloysius Kallig]]. In those [[Standard day/Legends|days]], [[Blood/Legends|bloodlines]] were regarded as very important, and Antinus recorded the genealogies of the greatest Sith Lords of his [[Time/Legends|time]]. Following his [[Death/Legends|passing]], he was [[Tomb of Vaius Antinus|buried]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], a fact that was well known to later [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologists]]. During his life, Antinus had also trained an [[Vaius Antinus's apprentice|apprentice]] whose name had been lost to history by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Given that both the [[Imperial Reclamation Service|Reclamation Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] took an interest in [[Tomb of Vaius Antinus's apprentice|the tomb of Antinus's apprentice]] on [[Aduba-6]], the record keeper was probably in some way affiliated with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] or the Jedi.<ref name="TOR" />
